scope: One record for every state-changing route outside the typed commands of the seven profile runtimes. A record names who can call the route, what it writes, why it lies outside the runtime-link relation, the ledger rows and decision records that cover it and the tests that execute it on its own runtime. The route inventory checks every reference against the tree and every cited test against its recorded run.

referenceTypes.ledgerRow: a row of an obligation ledger; it justifies a disposition only when its status is CLOSED and its coverage is this runtime
referenceTypes.decision: a quoted sentence of a decision record; it justifies a disposition only when its coverage is this runtime and the status line of the record starts with an accepted status; the Hook class record never justifies a disposition
referenceTypes.statement: a quoted statement inside a tracked record that is not a ledger row; it supports a disposition but does not justify it
referenceTypes.source: a source line with its exact occurrence count; an occurrence count of zero records an absence
referenceTypes.test: a test function of a suite; it executes the route on this runtime only when the test passed in its recorded run: the recorded Foundry results of the implementation suite (run recorded-foundry-suite) or a run of the disposition tests (run route-disposition-run)
referenceTypes.mutation: a mutation receipt with status KILLED whose original source hash equals the current source

dispositionKinds.ORDINARY_TOKEN_OPERATION: ERC-20 balance or allowance operation; balances follow the abstract ordinary transfer and no regulatory record is written
dispositionKinds.EXACT_USE_ROUTE: sensitive ERC-7943 selector that succeeds only while the typed wrapper holds a matching route ticket; every raw call reverts
dispositionKinds.GOVERNANCE_TRANSITION: governor-only administrative transition modelled as an atomic abstract transition
dispositionKinds.PROFILE_SYNCHRONISATION: permissionless synchronisation of the upstream frozen amount toward the owned target; no owned target, flag, case, record, nonce or receipt is written
dispositionKinds.ONE_WAY_SEAL: seal step that succeeds once and fixes the topology the commands rely on
dispositionKinds.CONSTRUCTION_ONLY: succeeds only inside the construction of the unit, exactly once, and reverts afterwards
dispositionKinds.NEVER_SUCCEEDS: no reachable state and caller lets the route succeed
dispositionKinds.BALANCE_CALLBACK: post-balance callback that moves the upstream frozen amount of the touched accounts to their owned targets saturated at the new balances
dispositionKinds.COMPLIANCE_CALLBACK: Compliance hook that only the bound token can call; it forwards the touched accounts to the balance callback and writes no storage of its own
dispositionKinds.UNIT_CREATION: creates a new conformance unit and writes no storage of an existing unit

dispositions.callers: any account, including a restricted one
writes: the allowance of the caller for one spender
Approval event
dispositions.justification: Sets one allowance entry of the caller and emits Approval; it reads and writes no balance, frozen target, restriction flag, custody record, effect head, case, action record, nonce, binding or receipt. An allowance moves no tokens by itself; tokens leave an account under an allowance only through transferFrom, which runs the ordinary transfer with its restriction and unfrozen capacity checks.

TrustAuthorityChanged event
dispositions.justification: The abstract authority rotation: the epoch advances by one and every command built under the earlier epoch becomes stale. The governance identifier is an operational guard with no abstract counterpart.

nonclaim: A record states why a route lies outside the runtime-link relation and which evidence covers it; it does not discharge the route-exhaustiveness condition by itself, a cited test is an execution on one deployment and not a proof over every caller, state or input, and the record does not authorize a merge, a release or a deployment.
